outages.description: A fault on the national grid caused a drop in Internet traffic from Bangladesh, mainly affecting eastern Dhaka and parts of Chattogram.
Ukrainian drone strikes on energy infrastructure caused power outages that disrupted Internet connectivity in Russian-occupied Crimea and Sevastopol
Russian strikes on energy infrastructure caused power outages that disrupted Internet connectivity in Zhytomyr Oblast, Ukraine
Armstrong (AS27364) customers in Pennsylvania, Ohio, New York and Kentucky experienced a brief Internet outage
A failure of equipment in the mobile core network of Orange (AS3215) caused a nationwide mobile network outage in France
Disruptions after data center drone strike
